result.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report
result.summary: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.

AI.brief_summary: MOSS-Image 是一份文本到图像生成系统的技术报告：从零预训练 5B 单流 DiT 以实现双语长文本渲染与布局控制，并配合意图感知的提示增强模块，同时提出长文本渲染与布局生成两个评测基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦图像合成质量、文本渲染与布局控制，不涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据获取或停止决策，其「意图感知提示增强」也仅服务图像生成规格，未呈现可迁移到 LVR 的状态或训练线索，故排除。
